summary: Tested new availability-ranges + clock picker feature end-to-end. Backend validation (weekly schedule, specific-day ranges, overnight range, invite time/clock validation, closed-day rejection) all PASS. Inviter end-to-end UI flow (open InviteDateModal, pick open day, pick time via clock/quick chip, fill 3 activities, ack, send) PASS. Owner-side profile availability UI (tabs, toggles, add/remove ranges, specific-day editor) renders & interacts correctly. HOWEVER: Profile Save button crashes the whole app for any owner whose relationship_intent is unset (e.g. admin seed). Root cause: Profile.jsx save() sets empty list fields to '' instead of [] for relationship_intent, backend returns 422 with detail=array-of-pydantic-errors, and toast.error(detail) tries to render an object array -> React 'Objects are not valid as a React child' runtime error. This blocks owner from saving availability from the UI.

ui_bugs.issue: DETAIL_KEYS normalization sends relationship_intent as '' instead of [] -> backend 422. Also orientations/genders/interests/passport_cities/relationship_intent are not in the list-field whitelist (only ['hobbies','languages_spoken','availability']). Any user without a saved relationship_intent cannot save profile.

toast.error(e.response?.data?.detail) crashes React with 'Objects are not valid as a React child' because FastAPI 422 returns detail as array of {type,loc,msg,input,url} objects. Needs stringification / typeof check.

action_items: Fix Profile.jsx save(): include relationship_intent, orientations, genders, interests, passport_cities (and any other List field) in the list-defaulting whitelist so they default to [] instead of ''.

Fix all axios error toasts (Profile.jsx, InviteDateModal, DateBookingModal, etc.) to safely stringify 422 detail arrays — e.g. `const d = e.response?.data?.detail; const msg = Array.isArray(d) ? d.map(x=>x.msg).join(', ') : (typeof d==='string'?d:t('failed'));`
Consider adding global axios response interceptor to normalize 422 payloads so individual callers don't have to.
critical_code_review_comments: Profile.jsx list-field normalization is brittle: 5+ List fields in ProfileUpdate (relationship_intent, orientations, genders, hobbies, languages_spoken, availability, interests, passport_cities) but only 3 are whitelisted. Easy to miss when adding new list fields.
FastAPI 422 responses are not uniformly handled on the frontend. Any un-caught 422 blown through `toast.error(detail)` will crash the SPA.

day_windows() backend returns None (no restriction) when user has no availability set at all, [] when restricted-but-closed-for-this-day. The /availability endpoint reports restricted correctly. Clear & consistent.
server.py is 4930 lines — strongly consider splitting into modules (users, dates, invites, availability, videocalls).

rca_of_the_issue: Owner UI Save failure RCA: 1) In Profile.jsx save(), code loops DETAIL_KEYS and sets empty/null fields to [] only for keys in ['hobbies','languages_spoken','availability']. relationship_intent is also List[str] in backend but gets set to ''. 2) Backend FastAPI rejects '' for List[str] with 422 (detail = list of ValidationError dicts). 3) Save catch block does `toast.error(e.response?.data?.detail || t('failed'))` — passes the ARRAY of error objects to sonner's toast which React tries to render => 'Objects are not valid as a React child' crash. Mitigation: extend list-field whitelist OR delete empty list fields before PATCH; and stringify the error detail safely.
